neighbours.label: urging the reader to act before a chance goes: ' out' in 'check it out while you can', ' before' in 'get one before it's gone', ' please' in 'please don't delay', firing there; plain statements on the same topics stay low
fire: The sale ends on Sunday, so check it out while you can.
Only a few mugs are left, so grab one before they're gone.
Spots are filling up fast, please don't wait!
The show closes this week, so see it while you still can.
This price won't last, so order now before it goes up.
Seats are going quickly, please book today!
The offer ends soon, so sign up while there's still time.
Stocks are low, so get yours before they sell out.
quiet: The sale was on Sunday, so we went with my aunt.
Only a few mugs are blue, so I bought a green one.
Spots appear on the leaves in spring, and they fade.
The show opened this week, and I saw it with a friend.
This price includes tax, so we paid it at the desk.
Seats are made of leather, and they feel soft.
The offer came in the mail, and my wife read it.
Stocks are lower, and bonds are a little higher.

short: urging: get it while you can
